description: This file defines a static utility class 'SiloAddressUtils' within the 'TestExtensions' namespace. The class provides a method to create a new local silo address using the Orleans runtime framework and network endpoint information.

classes.name: SiloAddressUtils
classes.description: A static utility class that offers methods for creating or handling silo addresses, specifically for testing purposes.

methods.name: NewLocalSiloAddress
methods.description: Creates a new local silo address with the specified generation number using the loopback network endpoint.

methods.name: NewLocalSiloAddress
methods.description: Creates and returns a new 'SiloAddress' object representing a local silo with a specific generation.
